selection_process: The EIL Selection Process for this recruitment is Interview-based; the notification does not mention a written examination or computer-based test. The prescribed qualification and experience are minimum requirements

and mere possession of them does not guarantee an interview call - EIL may restrict the number of candidates called by raising the minimum qualifying marks and/or the relevance of experience required.

Only shortlisted candidates will be informed via email for the interview. The interview will be conducted at New Delhi/Gurugram or through video conferencing; the venue/mode will be intimated separately to shortlisted candidates. Candidates working in PSU/Govt. Sector/Govt. Institutions must forward their application through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer at the time of interview
failing which their candidature will not be considered.
how_to_apply: EIL Apply Online is done entirely through the official EIL website; no offline or postal applications are accepted. The steps for EIL Apply Online are as follows.
Visit the EIL website at www.engineersindia.com → Career → Overview → Opportunities @ EIL.
Read all instructions on the website carefully before proceeding.
Fill in the online application form with all relevant, correct details.
Keep scanned copies of the required documents ready before starting registration (see Documents Required below).
Candidates are not required to send a printout of the application form by post; retain a copy - it will be required at the time of the personal interview, if shortlisted.
The cut-off date for post-qualification relevant experience and upper age is 31.08.2026.

EIL Apply Online will be open only between 0000 hrs on 11.09.2026 and 2359 hrs on 25.09.2026. Applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn, and requests for cancellation or resubmission will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: EIL Vacancy 2026 comprises 61 tentative vacancies spread across 22 positions. The number of vacancies indicated is tentative, and reservation and relaxation for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) will be as per Government of India guidelines. The full position-wise vacancy and reservation break-up is given below.

content_sections.heading: EIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: EIL Eligibility for this recruitment is assessed as on the cut-off date of 31.08.2026 and varies by position and grade. Only full-time regular courses are considered (except CA/CMA/CS qualifications), and the specified qualification must have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. A minimum of 65% marks (or equivalent CGPA) in the qualifying examination is required for all positions. The detailed qualification and post-qualification relevant experience for each position - as modified vide Addendum No. 01 dated 30.04.2026 - is given below, grouped by grade. Additional Eligibility Notes: Post-graduates in engineering (relevant to the post) get 1 year's relaxation in experience where the minimum qualification is BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.). Ph.D in Engineering (relevant to the post) gets 4 years' relaxation in experience where the minimum qualification is BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.). Candidates applying from a PSU/Govt. Sector must have completed a minimum of one year of service in the immediate lower pay scale (IDA) or equivalent (CDA) as on the date of application. Candidates applying against the OBC-NCL category must have a valid caste certificate, valid as on the closing date of applying (25.09.2026), uploaded at the time of application; applications without this will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for EIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must keep the following scanned documents ready before starting online registration: Latest passport-size colour photograph (.jpg/.jpeg, max 75 KB) Signature (.jpg/.jpeg, max 25 KB) Date of birth proof - Class X Certificate/Marksheet or Birth Certificate issued by Municipal Corporation/Govt. Authority (.jpg/.jpeg) All experience certificates Certificate/valid documentary proof regarding pay scale (as applicable, for PSU/Govt. Sector candidates), uploaded along with experience documents Disability certificate (PwD), if applicable (.jpg/.jpeg/.pdf, max 500 KB) Caste certificate - OBC/SC/ST/EWS, if applicable (.jpg/.jpeg/.pdf, max 500 KB) If shortlisted for interview, candidates must also bring original certificates with self-attested photocopies, including proof of age, all educational marksheets and certificates, proof of experience (service certificates with dates of joining/release), pay slips or salary certificates for the past 3 months, PwD certificate (if applicable), SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, and NATS/NAPS apprenticeship certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q1. What is EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: EIL Recruitment 2026 is a hiring drive by Engineers India Limited, a Navratna PSU, for experienced professionals against Advertisement No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/08, covering 22 positions at the Engineer, Deputy Manager, Manager and Senior Manager levels.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 61 tentative vacancies across 22 positions in various engineering, chemical, electrical, instrumentation, metallurgy and IT/AI disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes at 2359 hrs on 25.09.2026. Applications open from 0000 hrs on 11.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by position but is generally a BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) or MCA in the relevant discipline (Civil, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Metallurgy, Computer Science/AI/Data Science/IT) with a minimum of 65% marks, plus post-qualification relevant experience specific to each post. See the Eligibility section above for position-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 31.08.2026 is 28 years for Engineer, 32 years for Deputy Manager, 36 years for Manager, and 40 years for Senior Manager posts, with age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, PwD, Ex-Servicemen and Departmental candidates as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the EIL website (www.engineersindia.com → Career → Overview → Opportunities @ EIL) between 11.09.2026 and 25.09.2026, after keeping the required scanned documents ready.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for EIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through Interview at New Delhi/Gurugram or video conferencing; EIL may shortlist candidates by raising the minimum qualifying marks or experience relevance. No written exam is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for EIL Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay scales range from Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 for Engineer up to Rs. 90,000–2,40,000 for Senior Manager, with approximate Total CTC of Rs. 20.27 lakh to Rs. 30.52 lakh per annum depending on the grade.
